answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: full rewards need 12 trades with distinct counterparties, each sealed by a cipher-signed receipt forming a thread of history. A sybil farmer's fakes form an island, trading only with each other, so their diversity score stays zero, rewards locked. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 12,000 outside trades, about 60,000 POA in fees, far above the 12,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full share.
